segments.en: ..... And in the whole world in every voice (= language) he showed the way of truth; he distinguished truth from deceit, light from dark, the pious from the sinner and the just(?) from the wicked. (15) And ... all truth ... and .... {lines missing} (§362b) .... on .... who carries ... by his own power. (§363b) I worship and bless the sun and the moon, the great lights, and the powerful and ... powers which in them (conquer) the ... and the zealous ones; which make the world bright; which (are) the judge and witness (of the world) .... and themselves lead the (victo- rious) souls to that great and bright (land). (§364b) I worship and bless these five great lights, by which (they?) built and .... ... them .... .... and all lands ... .... and life self ... .... them. The land/world does not stand/endure. (§365b) I worship and bless all the gods, all the angels living and pure (who uphold this) outside(?) and in(side) at the wish of ... him, the great and the most powerful light, the lord of all the lands. (§366b) I worship and bless all the angels who are ruling/powerful in the whole land/ world and (who) restrain the demons and all badness and (who) receive(?) the whole community of the righteous from ... and (who) also protect (them) from the demons and who nurture goodness. (§367b) I worship and bless all the righteous wise and zealous ones, all who were earlier, those who stand/exist now and those, too, who ... are to be, who have known in truth and in greatness the pure (and the steadfast), all these; so that (all those who I worshipped) and I (glorified) (will help me and lead me) from all (re)birth to ... release to that realm of light on account of which he showed, (of the) .... and the true ones, the realm which (is?) all (peaceful) and pious. And (in) it evil-doing is (not). But immortal life ... of the living ones for ever and ... ... .... ... .... And never will (death be there).

segments.en: (§368b) (Blessed is?) everyone who will do this blessing with a pure heart and a true tongue and he will find (forgiveness with?) this blessing just as everything which ... ... he desires days (= daily?). And if he can/will(?) not praise many times; or (= at least?) let him bless three times daily. Gr. 98 by G. Fox and John Sheldon, 6 (Turnhout, 2010) 16-21 [I/I] <The> Prayer of the Emanations Fa(th)er of the Lights from pure intention. With a guileless word, you and your majesty and the wholly blessed aeons have been glorified and honoured. For you in glory have perfected their foundation. Your power and glory (10) and your light and word and your majesty and the aeons of blessing and all your counsel have been glorified. For you are G(o)d, the foundation of every grace and life and truth. (15) I worship and glorify all Gods, all Angels, all Splendours, all Luminaries, all Powers, those which are from the mighty and glorious F(ath)er, those which subsist in his holiness (20) and by his light are nourished, and purified from all darkness and evil intent. the Enlig[ht]ening Angels, (25) those who have advanced by (?) their own wisdom and have subjugated (?) the Darkness and its remorseless powers which were pre- pared to fight with the ruler of all; these are those (30) who ordered heaven and earth and bound in them all the substance of ar- rogance.

segments.en: the greatness, the enlig(h)tening (35) mind, the King (and) Christ, the one who came forth from the exterior ages into the upper creation and from that to this lower creation, (40) and having incomparably announced his wisdom and the ineffable mysteries to m(e)n on earth and having displayed to the entire kosmos the way of truth and (45) having expounded it with all voices, and having distinguished truth from the lie and light from darkness and good from evil and the just from the wicked. From you every (50) grace has become known to the universe, and life together with life and truth to every tribe has been interpreted with all voices. He himself has become for living souls the redeemer from the obligation of the bonds of the enemy. I wor(ship and glorify) the living G(o)d, virtuous and true, the one who, by his own power raised up all things, namely this arrangement above and below. I wor(ship and glorify) (60) the great luminaries, both the sun and the moon and the virtuous powers in them, which by wis- dom conquer the opponents and enlighten the entire (65) creation and are the overseers of all things and judge the world and conduct the victorious souls into the greatest aeon of light. [I/II] (70) I wor(ship and glorify) the five great lights, through which all the world came into existence and through which heaven and earth [were made] and by parti- cipation [in which] power and beauty and soul and (75) life are present in all. And without these the world could not exist. Angels, the living and pure, (80) who support this whole creation with the permi- ssion of the great and virtuous light, who rules over all those (now) who are praised in hymns.

segments.en: (85) I wor(ship and glorify) all the en- lightening angels who dominate the world and subjugate all demons and all (90) evil, shielding righteousness and guarding it from the wicked demons and increasing the good in it. (95) I worship and glorify all the just, those who have prevailed over all evil, those who both have existed before, exist now, are coming into existence and are (100) ready to come into existence, (be- cause they have recognised truth and all pre-eminence). (I worship) the chaste and steadfast, in order that all (105) those whom I have worshipped and glorified and invoked may assist me and bless me with favour and may deliver me from the bondage of all things and all stress and oppression and (110) every reincarnation, and provide me with access to the mighty aeon of light, which all the wise and (115) upright in knowledge hope to attain, where peace and the pure(s)t of the good rule, where there is no perception of evil but ambrosia (120) and eternal life are present, where all the inhabitants are without any need and experience neither death nor corruption. Blessed be he who will pray (125) this prayer frequently or at least (?) on the third day with a pure heart and forthright speech, asking for (130) forgiveness of sins committed. Amen. The Prayer of Emanations is ended.

segments.en: make full’) hymn 200 = T II D II 169) tr. MPs. 26-31. [II R/17] {Pa.} {§50c} Pwr krʾm (‘we will make full’) {Sogd.} has begun, the praise of Lord Jesus. {§51c} With a full mouth we make the blessing (āfrīwan), praise (γuβtyā) and honour to the great luminous moon (māx), the Saviour, the dear son of God Zurvan, [II/V] merciful Lord over the whole world. You we call with a great voice. Your light entered into our minds; and your power has gathered in our (5) limbs! {§52c} You are welcome, you are welcome, you are wel- come, light of the whole world! {§53c} You are welcome, our full soul (γryw)! {§54c} You are welcome, light (10) in our mind! {§55c} You are welcome, beneficent phy- sician, best of all physicians! {§56c} You are welcome, great life-giver, greatest of all life- givers. {§57c} You are welcome, third great one, from the ruler of the gods, God (15) Zurwa, our intercessor. {§58c} You are welcome, releaser of our soul (γryw) from amongst the dead! {§59c} You are welcome, our light eye and hearing ear! {§60c} You are welcome, (20) saviour of our soul (rwān), leader to immortal life! ...
